svg.title: IBLT set reconciliation: 5 peeling steps
svg.desc: Three hash regions show signed recoverable keys, the cells updated by each selected peeling step, and the final residual. Complete recovery: every residual field is zero. Checksums make recovery probabilistic.
svg.text: IBLT: peel the unordered set difference
18 cells | seed 42 | 5 peeling steps | 0 nonzero residual cells
COMPLETE: every residual field is zero
A dark outline marks the source cell. Key/check fields are hexadecimal. A count of zero alone does not mean empty.
